title: Homelab Overview
description: Start here: node capacity, workload availability, scrape coverage and active alerts for the whole homelab. No data means unknown, never healthy.

panels.title: Node CPU busy
panels.description: CPU time not spent idle, per node. NodeHighCPU fires above 90% for 5 minutes; use Pod CPU consumption by namespace to find the cause.

panels.title: Node memory available
panels.description: Memory the node can still give to workloads without swapping. NodeHighMemory fires below 10% available for 5 minutes; compare container working sets with their limits on the application dashboards.

panels.title: Node filesystem space used
panels.description: Used share of each real node filesystem (tmpfs, overlay, squashfs and /run excluded). Every hostpath volume shares this space; NodeFilesystemLowSpace fires above 85% used, see Platform - Storage.

panels.title: Persistent volume space used
panels.description: Kubelet-reported used share per PVC. A missing series is unknown, not an empty volume; openebs-hostpath volumes may report the whole node filesystem (see Platform - Storage).

targets.expr: 100 * max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes) / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes)

panels.title: Scrape coverage: 1 reachable, 0 failed, absent unknown
panels.description: Every Prometheus scrape target: 1 reachable, 0 failed. A target missing here is unknown, not healthy; check this table before trusting any other chart.

panels.title: Available / desired deployment replicas
panels.description: Available over desired replicas per Deployment, from Kubernetes readiness rather than a user journey. Below 1 means pods are not ready; check restarts and the owning application's dashboard.

panels.title: Ready / desired StatefulSet replicas
panels.description: Ready over desired replicas per StatefulSet, from Kubernetes readiness. Below 1 means a pod is not ready; check its restarts and logs.

panels.title: Observed container restarts / 15 minutes
panels.description: Container restarts per pod over the previous 15 minutes. PodFrequentRestarts fires at 3 or more; the application dashboards show whether they were OOM kills.

panels.title: Active alerts (empty is not proof of complete coverage)
panels.description: Pending and firing Prometheus alerts. Empty means no rule is firing, not that every component is covered; check scrape coverage too.

panels.title: Pod CPU consumption by namespace
panels.description: CPU cores used by all containers, summed per namespace. Use it to find the namespace behind high node CPU.

panels.title: Reported node pressure conditions
panels.description: Node conditions the kubelet currently reports as true: memory, disk or PID pressure. Any row means pods may be evicted; free the resource first.
